annotations.title: An allocation ETF or a built portfolio against an ETFIQ benchmark

description: Sets an allocation ETF, or a build_portfolio portfolio, beside an ETFIQ benchmark. With ticker (AOR): returns by window, difference, risk and cost against the benchmark for its look-through stock-share band. With portfolio (the answer's compare.arguments.portfolio): the benchmark's published windows, stock-share and fee differences, and portfolio_returns (hypothetical, same months). The default is the nearest strategic benchmark (choice.line says why; also gives the next-nearest when over 5 points away); pass benchmark to name another. An unknown name is refused (unknown-benchmark). Estimates nothing unpublished.

benchmark.description: Optional, with portfolio: a benchmark the reader names, by id (etfiq-strategic-80) or name. Omit for the default.

portfolio.description: The arguments build_portfolio took: its answer's compare.arguments.portfolio.

ticker.description: An allocation ETF, such as AOR.

name: compare_to_benchmark

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
